Subject: Planning: FY26 performance cycle — manager kits & sensitive-role privacy lanes

Team —

I want to get a tight plan in place for the FY26 performance cycle that explicitly separates the general manager-facing materials from the sensitive-role workflow (quiet comms, restricted routing, and legal signoffs). High-level ask: can we finalize the manager kit and the sensitive-role routing doc in the next four weeks so we can run a pilot with two orgs in November and a broader rollout in early December?

Key targets I propose:
- Manager kit first draft: 2026-11-10
- Sensitive-role routing & approvals: 2026-11-18
- Internal pilot with Engineering & Platform: 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-03
- Full launch (manager emails + forms + CS handoff): 2026-12-07

Attachments: manager_kit_outline.docx, sensitive_roles_routing.xlsx (outline).
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-fy26-performance-planning

Specific asks from each of you:
- Laura: own the manager kit content and manager talking points.
- Markus: review routing spreadsheet and confirm who on infra/product are considered sensitive roles for quiet-mode.
- Aditya: confirm legal requirements (consent, audit logging, limited disclosure) and whether we need DocuSign acknowledgements for managers handling privileged data.

I also want us to have a two-week silent period (no mass comms) for any sensitive roles so we can surface issues without broad visibility. If a manager needs to escalate, there should be a dedicated channel to People Ops + Legal.

I'll set a 30-minute sync after everyone has reviewed the attachments — propose Thu 10/22 11:00 PT.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of People Operations

Karthik / team —

Legal input in brief:
- Consent & notice: managers must be given a short guidance note on what info is allowed to be captured in a manager-only note vs. what triggers HR/Litigation hold. We should include that guidance as an appendix to the manager kit.
- DocuSign: ok to use for manager acknowledgement of handling privileged info; retention settings must be set to 7 years in our retention policy for signed agreements. Please confirm retention policy owner (I'm assuming Legal Ops).
- Audit trail: Markuss suggestion to add a People Ops + Legal check prior to distributing anything outside the calibration group is sensible. We should also ensure the system flags when a file contains PII or privileged notation.

Tara (ccd) — happy to loop you into a brief review of the sensitive-role excel and the manager acknowledgement language. Thanks.

-Aditya Rao
